Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente de SPM, para trabalhar de forma híbrida sendo os dias presenciais no Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo.

Ao assumir o cargo de Analista de Dados Pleno na Afya, seu objetivo principal será identificar e analisar as principais dores de negócios, aplicando técnicas e conceitos adequados. Ele deve integrar-se ao cotidiano da área de negócios, promovendo a autonomia no uso de dados. Além disso, é importante incentivar o uso de uma fonte única de verdade, evitando shadow IT. O profissional também deve realizar análises combinadas de dados internos e externos, criando painéis estratégicos. É essencial disponibilizar dados de forma simples e estruturada para apoiar decisões. Por fim, deve interagir autonomamente com as áreas de negócios para aprender sobre os diversos produtos e serviços da empresa.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Transformar perguntas de negócio em análises estratégicas, combinando SQL, planilhas e outras fontes, para orientar decisões críticas de produto, serviço e crescimento.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros e o time de dados na criação de pipelines, scripts e processos que garantam qualidade e confiabilidade das informações.
  • Aplicar métodos estatísticos e experimentais (A/B tests, análises causais, hipóteses) para avaliar impacto de mudanças em produto e identificar oportunidades de otimização.
  • Construir e evoluir dashboards estratégicos em Power BI, priorizando clareza e impacto, e guiando discussões sobre tendências, riscos e oportunidades.
  • Traduzir insights em storytelling executivo, conectando dados a narrativas claras e recomendações práticas para negócio e produto.
  • Entender profundamente o comportamento dos usuários, analisando engajamento, retenção e jornadas para antecipar melhorias de produto e apoiar decisões sobre novas features.
  • Analisar benchmarks e tendências de mercado, trazendo perspectivas externas que complementem os dados internos e apontem direções para inovação e competitividade.
  • Ser o ponto de contato confiável para áreas de negócio, disseminando conhecimento sobre métricas, catálogo de dados e boas práticas de governança.
  • Documentar e manter metadados, métricas e relatórios, garantindo consistência e rastreabilidade das informações usadas em decisões estratégicas.
  • Conduzir estudos analíticos ponta a ponta, do levantamento da necessidade até a comunicação de conclusões, influenciando priorização de roadmap e decisões de produto.
  • Zelar pela qualidade e integridade dos dados, propondo e implementando processos de monitoramento, validação e melhoria contínua.
  • Definir e refinar indicadores-chave de negócio, ajudando a empresa a medir o que realmente importa para crescimento sustentável.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • SQL avançado (queries complexas, CTEs, funções janela).
  • Python para análise de dados (Pandas, NumPy).
  • Métodos estatísticos aplicados: amostragem, testes, intervalos de confiança, experimentos/A/B.
  • Noções de tracking de produto (Segment, GA4, Snowplow) e taxonomia de eventos.

Diferenciais

  • Airflow ou outra ferramenta de orquestração.
  • Conhecimento em métricas de produto (retenção, engajamento, funil, cohort).

title: SVP, Finance & Operations
description:
At Sound Agriculture, we are revolutionizing the way the world grows food. Our innovative technology and solutions empower farmers to maximize nutrient efficiency, reduce environmental impact, and feed the world sustainably. Through a deeper understanding of plant and microbial biology, we are leveraging the natural power of plants to make agriculture more agile and resilient. If you’re passionate about cutting-edge science, making a real-world impact, and being part of a team that’s dedicated to transforming agriculture, we want you on our team!

Sound is a Series D startup funded by leading investors in food and agriculture including Leaps by Bayer, Syngenta Group Ventures, S2G Ventures, BMO Impact Investment Fund, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, Fall Line Capital, Cavallo Ventures, FootPrint Coalition and Northpond Ventures.

What we’re seeking:

We are seeking a finance and operations leader who has experience with physical products sold to farmers. We have a strong finance and accounting team in place and are looking for someone to add strategic oversight as the company continues to grow. The Senior Vice President is a critical leadership role for Sound as we continue our global expansion and scale towards $100M revenue, preparing for exit in the next two to four years. The ideal candidate has experience as a finance leader as well as a breadth of operational prowess, ensuring our systems and processes enable accurate, timely, and scalable business results.

This role serves as a member of the Leadership Team who works to develop and improve a resilient financial plan for the long-term that pursues high growth, while moving towards a near-term path to profitability. In addition to core financial leadership, it’s critical that this role also has experience connecting the financial health of the business to the operational elements of manufacturing and supply. The SVP is responsible for knowing our business in and out, representing our financial performance to the Board, and translating heavy data into meaningful insights for our employees and customers. Routine responsibilities include: audits, budgeting, monthly performance, cash runway strategies, supporting inventory and product logistics, M&A opportunities, and scenario analysis.

This position supervises the finance and accounting team and manages our legal and IT vendors/partners. The SVP, Finance & Operations reports to the CEO and may be based remotely across the United States.

Compensation Target

$220,000 to $250,000 base salary plus an annual bonus target of 25%

Bonuses are earned based on annual company and individual performance and are prorated based on start date. Sound reserves the ability to adjust the compensation range based on the final candidate’s experience, skillset, and geography. In addition to on target earnings, we offer above average equity grants for the industry as we believe that every employee should have a stake in the company’s growth. If you’re above this compensation target, we encourage you to reach out and discuss the entire package and opportunity before deciding not to pursue this position.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as an executive partner to the CEO and the leadership team with vital financial information and operational analytics, driving a culture of accountability across company KPIs, implementation of data-driven performance dashboards and quality improvement plans
  • Play a critical role as a thought-partner across the leadership team in developing strategies to hit our near and long term financial targets
  • Establish strong relationships with members of the Board of Directors, lead the Risk & Audit Sub-Committee and attend Board meetings and staff Board committees at the direction of the CEO
  • Financial Management and Strategic Decision Support
  • Develop and steward Sound’s financial strategy to maximize revenue growth while moving towards near-term profitability
  • Lead all financial planning and analysis functions, including developing Sound’s annual operating budgets, cash and working capital (A/R, A/P) management, financial forecasts, budget-variance process, scenario analyses and ad hoc financial analysis
  • Evaluate and advise on the impact of key strategic decisions, new product launches, market entry, joint ventures and strategic partnerships
  • Steward and grow cash, minimize currency risk, and execute the company’s Treasury function
  • Supply Optimization
  • Ensure our supply and demand forecasts are optimized for maximum sales and minimal excess inventory
  • Collaborate and improve our S&OP process each month
  • Lead the strategy to optimise supply chain for new markets (initially LATAM and EU)
  • Engage in manufacturing partnerships that enhance our current practices, processes, and relationships
  • Support logistics efforts, warehousing, and returns
  • Legal and Administrative
  • Manage corporate and commercial legal activities, including financial closings, co-promotion, licensing, development and collaboration agreements

Targeted Skills & Experience

  • Experience leading finance and accounting functions at companies with a manufacturing component and/or physical supply chain non-negotiable. Candidates without this experience will be declined at application review.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Business Management required; Master’s degree or CPA a strong plus
  • Experience with new product launches and international market entry, with direct accountability over key financial and/or operating metrics
  • Strong critical thinking skills; able to see the big picture, prioritize critical focus areas, and generate strategic options
  • Partnership approach to collaborating with business leaders to earn trust and solve challenges quickly through influence and ownership
  • Polished modeling and presentation skills, able to synthesize complex technical and business concepts with both narratives and numbers for executive audiences and the company alike, adjusting tone as appropriate
  • High attention to detail, able to quickly review complex financial models and analyses and spot errors and potential to improve their use and accuracy
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills across levels with an ability to persuade, influence, and build enthusiasm and commitment
  • Supply chain experience, specifically as it relates to the agriculture industry or another chemical industry corollary.

This role demonstrates our values by:

  • Creativity: Explores new ways to solve routine challenges with an emphasis on simplicity. Leads with curiosity and seeks to understand rather than implement established practices that may not address the core issue.
  • Boldness: Position the company for continued growth and category leadership, both deepening and expanding our product reach.
  • Ownership: Operate as a player-coach, willing to dive into details and fully own outcomes and financial decisions like the company’s money is your own.
  • Tenacity: Pushing on outcomes and efforts when conviction is high and don’t shy away from tough conversations or decisions.

What we offer:

  • Opportunity to work in an incredible team with a drive to build alternative solutions to age old practices that increase farmer ROI
  • Competitive total rewards package including base compensation, performance bonus structure or uncapped commission plan for sales positions, and above market equity
  • Comprehensive health care plans including Medical, Dental and Vision coverage
  • Flex Spending Account (Healthcare, Dependent Care & Commuter Benefit for US-based employees)
  • Health Savings Account with monthly employer contribution (for US-based employees on qualifying health plans)
  • 401(k) with 3% company match (for US-based employees)
  • Flexible time off policy empowering employees to use time how they need, when they need
  • Mental health and wellbeing benefits - including dedicated monthly meeting free Focus Days
  • Paid parental leave (for US-based employees)
  • Regular events and engagement activities (we actually like hanging out with each other!)

Sound Agriculture does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third party recruiting agencies responding to job postings. We will not respond to unsolicited requests to submit candidates.

We seek a diverse pool of applicants and consider all qualified candidates regardless of race, ancestry, color, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, citizenship, disability, Veteran status, marital status, or any other protected status.

Sound participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, Sound is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before Sound takes any action, including terminating your employment.

Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast-growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on-boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

  • Support new Fund Administration, Portfolio Insights, and Valuations' clients by on-boarding them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client’s limited partners list, investments, capitalization table and securities
  • Extract relevant information from operating agreements and subscription documents to upload limited partners to Carta
  • Analyze data thoroughly and precisely to maintain data integrity throughout the on-boarding process
  • Liaise between sales and Investor Services teams as the bridge post-sales through implementation
  • Coordinate and manage multiple/simultaneous implementation projects by continually communicating with and motivating clients
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on-boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on-boarding experience for customers

The Impact You’ll Have

You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.

About You

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem-solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world-class on-boarding experience.

  • Proven success in a project management capacity

  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Passionate, tactical, and direct, with an ambitious attitude and a proven history to go above and beyond baseline requirements

Salary

About the Role

You will work closely with the product and credit teams to build go-to-market functions for our lending decisioning engine. You’ll debug and resolve complex issues independently, anticipate potential blockers, and help unblock others when needed.

You will evaluate scope and requirements critically by surfacing ambiguities early, challenging assumptions, and reframing trade-offs to ensure clarity before execution. Progress, risks, and blockers should be communicated proactively through tickets, stand-ups, and async updates to keep teammates and stakeholders aligned.

You will provide detailed peer reviews that improve code quality, maintainability, and extensibility. In addition, you’ll drive continuous improvement by identifying technical debt, proposing design or tooling enhancements, and sharing best practices that increase team velocity and reliability.

About the Team

The team develops Clutch's real-time lending decisioning engine. We work closely with Credit, Product, and Implementation teams to increase auto-decision rates and reduce funding time for our credit union partners. The team operates with a clear cadence and shared rituals, using narrative-driven planning and continuous improvement to ship reliably while collaborating across the broader Lending org.

Engineers own outcomes end to end, from discovery and decision-ready specs through rollout, monitoring, and follow-ups.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Debug and resolve issues independently, providing clear root-cause analysis and documenting learnings.

  • Take ownership of smaller features end-to-end, from clarifying requirements to deployment.

  • Build working knowledge of decisioning engine features and rules, being able to explain their impact on the product.

  • Proactively ask questions, surface risks, and challenge assumptions early to improve clarity and scope of work.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Drive predictable delivery by proactively communicating progress, risks, and blockers without being prompted.

  • Confidently operate on lending decisioning context, making informed tradeoffs and documenting decisions.

  • Lead technical implementation for a feature or partner go-live, coordinating with stakeholders for alignment.

  • Anticipate potential problems in requirements or design, reframing them with data and alternative solutions before they become blockers.

  • Contribute high-quality code reviews that not only ensure standards, but also provide mentorship and elevate peers’ design and coding practices.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Lead and deliver a small-to-medium scoped project independently, including technical design, planning, and rollout.

  • Build trust with cross-functional and external stakeholders by representing engineering context and constraints clearly.

  • Proactively identify technical debt or process gaps and drive initiatives to resolve them with measurable impact.

  • Demonstrate readiness for the next level by consistently owning delivery, influencing peers, and shaping team practices that raise the overall bar.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong product-oriented mindset, able to connect technical decisions with business impact.

  • Proven ability to debug and resolve complex issues independently, providing clear root-cause analysis and documenting learnings.

  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Credit, Implementation, and external stakeholders to align on scope and trade-offs.

  • Consistent ownership of small-to-medium projects end-to-end, from discovery and design to deployment and follow-up.

  • Ability to critically evaluate requirements, anticipate risks, and propose pragmatic alternatives that improve clarity and delivery outcomes.

  • Advanced English skills, both spoken and written.

  • Plus: previous experience with loan origination systems is a strong differentiator.

Please note that this role may evolve as our business needs change, so we appreciate your flexibility and adaptability.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.

  • Unforgettable Off-Sites: Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.

  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays: Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.

  • Stock Options: Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.

  • Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.

  • Work Trip Budget: Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

Please note: This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we\'re 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model: you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product\'s modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position:

  • Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.

  • Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.
  • Ensure upcoming product needs and opportunities aligned with your Engineering Director and Country Managers to create a coherent Product & Tech Strategy and Roadmap.
  • Champion a hands-on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first-hand customer/user insights.
  • Create a culture of decision-making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.
  • Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.

  • Experience in modernizing tech debt whilst delivering product value is a plus
  • Hands-on: In Docplanner, being a people manager does not mean only managing people, but being able to dive in the details of problems, opportunities & solutions.

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Revenue Operations Sr Analyst to strengthen our sales strategy and accelerate our go-to-market engine in a rapidly growing SaaS company. You will partner with Sales, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Data teams to design scalable processes, implement effective incentives and structures, and ensure execution aligns with business priorities. This is a high-impact role with strong visibility and influence across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Sales and executive leadership to define the go-to-market strategy —including segmentation, sales motions, and revenue growth priorities.
  • Design and continuously refine quota-setting frameworks, territory models, and headcount planning to enable scalable growth.
  • Develop compensation strategies and incentive structures that drive exceptional performance while aligning with company objectives.
  • Build and manage strategic dashboards and frameworks to monitor sales productivity, forecast accuracy, CAC payback, and other core SaaS KPIs; conduct deeper analysis using Excel/Google Sheets as needed.
  • Translate business questions into analytical projects , delivering actionable insights to guide product focus, market entry, and commercial efficiency.
  • Drive operational rigor through annual/quarterly planning cycles, cross-functional alignment, and performance reviews.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across tools, data flows, and CRM workflows (HubSpot) to enhance efficiency at scale.

Requirements

  • 3–4 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Business Operations , preferably within a SaaS or technology company.
  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets and CRM tools (HubSpot knowledge is a plus | SQL, Python is a plus ).
  • Solid understanding of SaaS metrics, sales cycles, and revenue motions (new business, upsell, retention).
  • Excellent communication skills in English (both written and verbal).
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and independently lead complex initiatives.
  • Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a related field .

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work in a high-growth SaaS environment with global exposure.
  • Direct impact on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth .
  • Collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial culture .
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

This is a role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time (BRT), and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

Application

This position is exclusively for Brazil-based engineering talent on a CLT contract paid in BRL. Relocation will not be considered at this time.

You will be required to speak English daily in written and verbal communication with our global (Brazil and U.S. team).

title: Freight Coordinator
description:
Commitment: Full-time (Approx. 40 hours/week)

Company Overview:

Tidal is a Direct Placement Agency that helps job seekers find job opportunities for real growth. We work with stable, responsible businesses experienced in remote hires and are excited to welcome international team members. Tidal is owned and operated by consumer brand owners and operators. We have offshore team-building experience and aim to help businesses leverage global talent.

About This Role:

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Freight Coordinator to join the Logistics team of one of our valued clients. The right candidate will thrive in a remote setting and be responsible for managing the end-to-end freight scheduling and delivery process. This includes coordinating pickups and deliveries, handling exception management, overseeing return shipments, and ensuring data accuracy. The ideal candidate will be proactive, possess strong communication skills, and have a deep understanding of logistics and freight operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Communicate with carriers, freight forwarders, 3PL warehouses, and retail partners to coordinate pickup and delivery schedules.
  • Schedule and confirm inventory pick-ups from 3PL warehouses based on shipping plans.
  • Coordinate delivery appointments with retail partners and carriers to ensure timely arrivals.
  • Manage shipping documentation, including BOLs, labels, packing slips, and invoices.
  • Track shipments in transit and provide timely updates to stakeholders.
  • Monitor delivery status and resolve issues like delays, missed pick-ups, and damage claims.
  • Handle reverse logistics and manage return shipments from stores to 3PL warehouses.
  • Ensure accurate documentation and tracking of returned inventory.
  • Maintain shipment logs, track KPIs, and prepare regular performance reports.
  • Act as the main point of contact for freight scheduling and updates with internal and external teams.

Software/Platforms/Tools:

  • ERP Software (e.g., Netsuite)
  • TMS (Transportation Management Systems)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)
  • Shipment tracking tools
  • Excel
  • Google Sheets
  • Google Suite
  • Slack
  • Zoom
  • Monday.com

Qualifications:

  • At least 3-5 years of freelancing experience
  • 2+ years of experience in freight coordination, logistics, or supply chain support, ideally with retail and/or 3PL exposure.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple shipments and exceptions simultaneously.
  • Experience working with ERP (e.g., Netsuite), TMS (Transportation Management Systems), WMS (Warehouse Management Systems), or shipment tracking tools.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proficiency with Excel and Google Sheets for shipment tracking and reporting.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote/offshore environment and manage time zones effectively.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience working with U.S.-based logistics operations.
  • Familiarity with retail distribution and reverse logistics processes.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

At Boulevard, our Customer Experience team is dedicated to launching, supporting, and strengthening relationships with our clients. As an Onboarding Specialist , Data Migrations , you will play a pivotal role in helping customers transition from legacy systems to the Boulevard platform with minimal disruption and maximum confidence.

You'll be the technical partner behind the scenes—transforming, cleaning, and validating data to ensure accuracy, security, and a seamless migration experience. From pre-sale planning through post-launch cleanup, you'll own end-to-end data migration workflows while collaborating cross-functionally to ensure every customer launch is a success.

What you'll do here:

Pre-Sale & Scoping

  • Meet with prospective clients pre-close to understand their data needs and align migration expectations.
  • Partner with Sales to scope technical requirements and validate feasibility.
  • Participate in customer and prospect calls as a subject matter expert on data migrations.

Data Migration & Import

  • Own and manage full-service and free import migrations from initial planning through final execution.
  • Perform imports using tools such as Flatfile and Google Sheets with high accuracy and consistency.
  • Execute structured QA and validation checks on all data prior to launch.
  • Handle migration-related CFDs/CSRs and execute bulk updates (e.g., pricing changes, contact edits).
  • Clean up migrations on launch day in partnership with Onboarding Specialists, focusing on data integrity.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration

  • Coordinate full-service migrations with teams like Odetta and Customer Operations (COPS).
  • Work closely with Engineering to manage escalations, track bugs, and improve tooling.
  • Partner with COPS and Engineering on Flatfile improvements and onboarding tools.
  • Support Onboarding Specialists in resolving real-time data issues during customer launches.

Operational & Team Support

  • Track migration timelines, coordinate launch calendars, and communicate progress and blockers clearly.
  • Answer internal team questions in shared Slack channels (#onboarding-questions, etc.).
  • Assist in data review for proof-of-concept migrations for strategic accounts.
  • Create and maintain internal documentation and one-sheets related to migrations and tooling.

What you'll need to thrive:

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience managing data migrations or working with platform dashboards.
  • 1+ year of direct experience with Boulevard dashboard and data migrations (preferred).
  • Advanced skills in Google Sheets or Excel -comfortable with formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and structured data manipulation.
  • Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving abilities under pressure.
  • Excellent project and time management—able to juggle multiple migrations simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
  • Highly detail-oriented with a strong commitment to data accuracy and security.
  • Clear, confident communicator with the ability to collaborate across departments and work independently.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with Flatfile or similar structured import tools.
  • Experience with SaaS onboarding, technical support, or customer implementation.
  • Knowledge of data privacy best practices, especially around marketing consent and HIPAA customer data handling.

How we'll take care of you:

Your starting budgeted cash compensation for this role is between $64,000 - $92,000, depending on your current skills, experience, training, and overall market demands. This total compensation range is subject to change, and there is always room for growth and advancement.

In addition to the wonderful people you'll get to work with and challenging projects that'll push you - Boulevard is here to make sure you're always at the top of your game emotionally, mentally, and physically.

  • We've got you covered with a 401(k) match plus dental, medical, vision, and life insurance.
  • Take a break whenever you need with our flexible vacation day policy.
  • Fully remote so you can choose where you want to work. You'll receive a work from home stipend every month.
  • Family planning resources and specialized support programs.

The E-Commerce Marketing Manager (LATAM Marketplaces) will lead strategy and execution across Mercado Libre and other key Latin American platforms.   • A. Strategic Planning
  • Develop and implement eCommerce marketing strategies for Mercado Libre and other market places in Argentina, Chile, Peru, Colombia, Ecuador, and other assigned accounts.
  • Identify marketing activities that support growth initiatives on marketplace platforms
  • B. Account Management
  • Act as the primary point of contact for marketing activities for assigned accounts.
  • Manage relationships with key stakeholders to ensure alignment on goals and promotions.
  • C. Performance Analysis
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance, traffic metrics, and KPIs for all accounts.
  • Ability to prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly reports and insights for stakeholders.
  • Understand customer search trends & Cricut’s brand positioning within each platform
  • D. Campaign Management
  • Plan and execute marketing campaigns tailored to each platform/marketplace.
  • Manage promotional calendar, including product launches and seasonal promotions.
  • Maintain pacing levels within monthly, quarterly, & annual budgets
  • E. Content Development
  • Oversee the creation and optimization of product listings to improve visibility and conversion rates.
  • Work closely with product marketing to ensure high-quality content
  • Manage brand stores within accounts, ensuring optimal customer shopping experience
  • F. Pricing and Inventory Management
  • Provide discovered insights around pricing & inventory to sales lead. Sales lead will own overall pricing & inventory, but marketing can provide insights from marketing-related findings.
  • Support sales with supply chain and pricing teams to set competitive pricing strategies.
  • Support sales with monitoring inventory levels to prevent stockouts and ensure timely replenishment. Monitor lost buy box % on Amazon.

Comprehensive report outlining quarterly marketing strategies and budget allocations for respective countries and assigned accounts.

Campaign Performance Analysis

Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly performance reports detailing successes, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.

Optimized Product Listings

Promotional Calendar

III. Tasks

A. Daily Tasks

  • Monitor sales and traffic data across all accounts.
  • Respond to inquiries from Amazon account representatives and the third-party reseller.
  • Walk the store of key accounts & channels to ensure positive customer experience

B. Weekly Tasks

  • Review performance metrics and adjust marketing strategies as needed.
  • Audit & optimize paid search accounts (budgets, keyword coverage, cleanup, bid adjustments)
  • Conduct competitor analysis to identify trends and opportunities

C. Monthly Tasks

  • Hold strategy and performance review meetings with stakeholders.
  • Prepare monthly Amazon review deck for key accounts
  • Plan upcoming monthly campaigns and promotional activities.

D. Quarterly Tasks

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to track KPIs and deliver actionable insights.
  • Experience managing product listings, brand stores, and promotional calendars.

Overview

About Skillshare

Skillshare is the leading learning community for creatives. With more than 30,000 expert-led classes in illustration, design, photography, video, marketing, and more, Skillshare empowers anyone, anywhere to learn new skills, share expertise, and unlock their creative potential.

Hundreds of thousands of member subscribers around the world come to Skillshare to discover new passions, advance careers, and connect with an inspiring community of teachers and peers.

Backed by top investors including Newspring Capital, OMERS Ventures, and Union Square Ventures, our mission is to build the world’s most thriving creative learning community.

The Role

We’re looking for a data-driven and strategic Paid Search Manager to own and optimize our campaigns across the Google Ads portfolio. Reporting to the Performance Marketing Lead, you will be responsible for driving profitable growth and maximizing subscription volume at an efficient CAC. This role sits at the core of our growth engine, requiring a deep understanding of campaign management, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration to drive subscriptions and improve conversion rates across the funnel. You will be responsible for strategy, execution, and reporting, making data-driven decisions to scale our paid search efforts effectively.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize campaigns across the full Google Ads portfolio, including Search, PMax, YouTube, Video Action, and others.
  • Lead keyword strategy and bidding across both branded and non-branded queries to maximize subscription volume at an efficient CAC.
  • Run a disciplined test-and-learn program across bidding, targeting, and funnel variations, and partner with internal data teams to evolve dashboards that surface actionable insights.
  • Drive Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) initiatives within your channels by working cross-functionally with engineering and design to develop, implement, and maintain a testing roadmap.
  • Monitor campaign performance, generate actionable insights from data, and communicate data-driven decisions to key stakeholders.
  • Stay current on Google Ads and performance marketing trends, platform changes, privacy regulations, attribution strategies, and AI-powered search features to maximize performance.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: You have 3+ years of hands-on experience managing SEM and running PPC campaigns in Google Ads, ideally in a fast-paced environment like a subscription business or an agency.
  • Data-driven mindset: You have fluency in campaign data analysis and optimization, with proficiency in Google Sheets, cohort analysis, and ROAS modeling. You have a proven ability to translate numbers into actions.
  • Platform Expertise: You have a strong understanding of search and Google-owned ad placements, including Search, PMax, YouTube, App Campaigns, and Demand Gen.
  • Cross-functional collaborator: You have the ability to work effectively with product, web, creative, and analytics teams to optimize acquisition performance from end to end.
  • Excellent communicator: You can translate complex insights into clear decisions and communicate effectively to stakeholders within and outside of the marketing team.
  • Strategic owner: You are comfortable owning strategy, execution, and reporting, and are curious, commercially aware, and comfortable making quick decisions.
  • Mission alignment: You’re excited by Skillshare’s vision of building the world’s most thriving creative learning community.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with other performance marketing channels such as Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit and others.
  • Experience with international markets outside of the US or managing global accounts.
  • Experience within startup or scale-up environments.
  • Experience working with ed-tech or subscription based companies.

At Skillshare, we believe creativity thrives in an inclusive environment. We’re excited to meet candidates from all backgrounds and experiences. If you’re passionate about what we do but don’t check every single box, we’d still love to hear from you — curiosity and growth matter most to us.

title: Coordenador de Segurança de identidade e acessos
description:
Coordenador de Segurança de identidade e acessos

Horário: Segunda a sexta-feira, das 08h30 às 18h00. Modalidade: Home Office

Missão do Cargo : Liderar a unidade de Segurança em Identidades e Acessos da Solo Iron, garantindo a entrega de serviços especializados com alto padrão técnico, alinhados à estratégia de cibersegurança da organização e ao valor agregado esperado pelos clientes.

O coordenador será responsável por estruturar, documentar, sustentar e evoluir os processos da área, além de desenvolver a equipe tecnicamente e operacionalizar controles de qualidade, métricas e melhoria contínua.

O foco central do cargo é transformar diretrizes de IAM/IGA em operações eficientes, seguras e auditáveis, com base em boas práticas e frameworks reconhecidos (NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, Zero Trust Architecture, Microsoft Identity Security Framework, IGA Market Guides e CIS Controls).

Principais Atividades

Liderança Estratégica

  • Traduzir objetivos de negócio em estratégias claras de identidade e acesso;
  • Atuar junto à diretoria, GRC, engenharia de segurança e arquitetura para alinhar entregas de IGA;
  • Consolidar a visão de IAM como função crítica para segurança e conformidade.

Governança e Processos

  • Estruturar e documentar processos (RACI, fluxogramas, SOPs);
  • Implementar controles operacionais de qualidade, com indicadores de eficiência e maturidade;
  • Garantir aderência a auditorias, regulações (LGPD, SOX, ISO) e políticas internas.

Excelência Operacional e Entrega de Valor

  • Gerenciar projetos e operações recorrentes da equipe de IAM, assegurando previsibilidade e acurácia;
  • Definir e acompanhar OKRs, SLAs e KPIs da área;
  • Sustentar operações modernas de:
    • Governança de acesso (recertificações, SoD, RBAC, JIT/JEA);
    • Administração segura de AD e Entra ID (Tiering, PAW, Break-Glass, PIM);
    • Integração com SIEM, UEBA e MITDR em parceria com outras áreas.

Desenvolvimento de Equipe

  • Conduzir mentorias técnicas e comportamentais;
  • Definir trilhas de capacitação e evolução individual;
  • Promover cultura de autonomia, responsabilidade e aprendizado contínuo.

Requisitos Técnicos e Experiência

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Active Directory: arquitetura segura, GPOs, trusts, replication, hardening (CIS Benchmarks, Microsoft Baselines);
  • Domínio de Azure Entra ID e Entra ID Governance, incluindo integração com ambientes on-premises;
  • Experiência em arquitetura de IAM/IGA, com visão estratégica e orientação a resultados;
  • Vivência na liderança de equipes técnicas em segurança da informação.

Habilidades e Competências

  • Integridade
  • Respeito
  • Qualidade
  • Excelência no atendimento
  • Inovação
  • Comprometimento
  • Liderança

description:
Sobre o Wellz

Em 2021, o Wellhub fundou o Wellz com o objetivo de democratizar a saúde mental no Brasil. Possibilitamos que empresas ajudem suas equipes a serem mais saudáveis, mais resilientes e mais engajadas. Através da nossa plataforma, é possível realizar atendimento clínico individual online, acessar conteúdos interativos sobre saúde mental e participar de rodas de conversa em grupo. Facilitamos o acesso das pessoas a uma jornada de autocuidado e autoconhecimento que seja ideal para as suas necessidades individuais. A abordagem que utilizamos é a Terapia Cognitivo Comportamental, com intervenções voltadas para a melhora clínica individual e baseadas em evidências.

A oportunidade

O Wellz está crescendo e, por isso, estamos procurando psicólogos e psicólogas com experiência clínica para fazer parte da nossa comunidade. Você receberá pacientes, realizará sessões de psicoterapia, terá acesso a supervisão gratuita e fará parte de uma inovadora solução de cuidado à saúde mental.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Psicologia;
  • Especialização ou pós-graduação completa em Terapia Cognitivo Comportamental;
  • Experiência prévia realizando psicoterapia online individual;
  • Inscrição ativa no Conselho Regional de Psicologia (CRP);
  • Habilidades para conduzir atendimentos de forma online;
  • Possuir computador para realização de atendimento clínico, assim como outros equipamentos que garantam a qualidade do atendimento;
  • Ter empresa aberta, cuja atividade seja compatível com serviços psicológicos.

Por que fazer parte do time de parceiros do Wellz?

  • Nova fonte de renda, sem custo extra para se juntar à nossa rede;
  • Acesso a novos pacientes, trazidos diretamente até você;
  • Flexibilidade de horário, com a possibilidade de criar a sua própria agenda;
  • Metodologia comprovada, baseada em dados e tecnologia;
  • Comunidade de terapeutas para dividir aprendizados e melhores práticas;
  • Supervisão clínica sem custo e com orientação direcionada;
  • Acesso ao Wellhub para cuidar da sua saúde de forma integral.

Compromisso com a inclusão

O Wellz é para todas as pessoas, independente da religião, orientação sexual, etnia, gênero e outros. Se você preenche os requisitos necessários, inscreva-se e venha fazer parte dessa rede que só cresce!

Essa oportunidade é referente a uma parceria de prestação de serviços e, dessa forma, não configura vínculo empregatício.

Join to apply for the role of Pessoa Supervisora Trade Execução - Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro at The HEINEKEN Company.

Missão do cargo

Responsável pela negociação e implementação das estratégias de trade junto aos clientes de off premise, atuando como gestor da equipe de promotores, supervisionando e desenvolvendo esses profissionais para executar com sucesso as nossas marcas no mercado, visando maximizar os negócios dos clientes e da Heineken Brasil.

Principais atribuições

  • Assegurar a excelência na execução das estratégias definidas para o canal na sua região (Fotografia de sucesso) através do acompanhamento in loco da execução das atividades nas lojas de AS e acompanhamento de pesquisas de mercado;
  • Identificar e desenvolver oportunidades de negócios, visando o incremento de volume, espaço e crescimento do mix de segmentados nos clientes potenciais, através de visita/prospecção destes clientes no mercado;
  • Assegurar o cadastro de todos os produtos contemplados no mix dentro das lojas de sua responsabilidade, respeitando o guia de FDS para marcas e embalagens prioritárias e sugeridas;
  • Garantir que a equipe de promotores tenha condições de implementar as ações de trade marketing, ativando os pontos de vendas, através da gestão do estoque mínimo, aplicação dos materiais promocionais, negociação de espaço e cumprimento das contrapartidas acordadas;
  • Garantir que o estoque virtual dos clientes esteja zerado, através do acompanhamento da ferramenta de gestão, evitando ruptura de nossos produtos no PDV;
  • Monitorar o cumprimento das políticas de preço, através do acompanhamento in loco, visando informar eventuais desvios de preço e atuar nas correções, quando possível;
  • Assegurar a valorização da marca dos nossos produtos no ponto de venda, através da aplicação correta dos materiais de merchandising e coordenação das atividades promocionais implementadas nos clientes;
  • Supervisionar e desenvolver a equipe de promotores com intuito de capacitá-los a executar as diretrizes de execução das nossas marcas, garantindo conhecimento técnico e cumprimento das rotinas estabelecidas;
  • Realizar rotas regulares no mercado em todas as lojas da carteira, visando o acompanhamento da execução através de coaching ao promotor e da avaliação de loja (FDS);
  • Acompanhar o resultado das ações implantadas dentro do canal sugerindo melhorias sempre que necessário;
  • Análises de sell in e sell out por Rede/Lojas/Rotas ou análises especiais (conforme necessário ou identificado);
  • Gestão dos ativos da Cia junto ao mercado (Refrigeradores / Racks / Beer box/ Demais Materiais permanentes).

Formação acadêmica

Superior cursando, sendo 70% do curso já completo.

Requisitos

  • Ter CNH B ativa e definitiva
  • Excel Intermediário
  • Experiência com gestão de pessoas

Benefícios

Oferecemos cuidado com a saúde com assistência médica, odontológica, telemedicina, cartão Farmácia, seguro de vida e previdência privada. Programas de apoio psicológico, orientação jurídica e financeira, Gympass, Programa de Gestantes com licença maternidade de 180 dias e paternidade de até 30 dias, vale alimentação e vale refeição, vale transporte, loja exclusiva para colaboradores (Heistore) e oportunidades de desenvolvimento pela Universidade HEINEKEN, parcerias educacionais e programa de idiomas. Programa interno Be Leader para liderança.

title: Surveyor I
description:
The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

Promovemos um ambiente acolhedor e respeitoso para todos, valorizando as diferenças de gênero, etnia, deficiências, orientação sexual (LGBTI+), crenças, religiões e outras individualidades. title: Unit Chief for the Amazonia Forever Regional Program
description:
Overview

This is an international staff role based at our Headquarters in Washington, D.C. We offer visa and relocation support.

We improve lives

The IDB Group is a community of diverse, versatile, and passionate people who come together on a journey to improve lives in Latin America and the Caribbean. Our people find purpose and do what they love in an inclusive, collaborative, agile, and rewarding environment.

About This Position

The Amazonia Forever Unit has rapidly positioned itself as a strategic leader in advancing sustainable development across the Amazonia region. In just three years, it has mobilized over $4.2 billion in operations across eight countries, launched innovative financing mechanisms, including Indigenous-led funds. Coordinated the first loans under the Green Climate Fund and the Amazon Bioeconomy and Forest Management Fund. Through regional networks, knowledge platforms, and global partnerships, the Unit has strengthened institutional capacities, promoted inclusive growth, and elevated the IDB’s leadership in Amazonia-related development.

We are seeking a strategic leader to serve as Unit Chief for the Amazonia Forever Regional Program. This role is central to advancing sustainable and inclusive development across the Amazonia region, which is home to nearly 40% of South America’s landmass. The Unit Chief will lead cross-sectoral efforts, manage funding mechanisms, and coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure impactful and cohesive development strategies.

This position will report to the Manager of the Southern Cone Department. It will advise and support the Vice Presidency of Countries and Regional Integration, as well as the CSC, CAN, and CCB Managers, in the preparation, development, and implementation of national and regional dialogues, strategies, and activities related to the Amazonia Forever Program.

What you’ll do

As Unit Chief, you will lead and manage the Amazonia Forever Regional Program within the Bank and its funding mechanisms and coordinate the external partners and networks that are part of the Program.

Regional Dialogues & Country Engagement

  • Coordinate high-level dialogues across Amazonia-region countries, in close collaboration with Country Representatives, to identify shared priorities and build consensus around strategic development goals.
  • Align Amazonia Forever Program goals with Country Strategies, ensuring coherence across sectors and countries.
  • Engage diverse partners and stakeholders to shape initiatives within the Amazonia Forever Program.

Operational Strategy & Policy Development

  • Advise senior management on the formulation of operational strategies, policies, and guidelines tailored to the Amazonia region.
  • Promote implementation of the program’s five key pillars:
  • Combating deforestation and strengthening environmental control and security.
  • Bioeconomy and creative economy.
  • People-centered development.
  • Sustainable cities, infrastructure, and connectivity.
  • Sustainable, low-carbon agriculture, livestock, and forestry.
  • Integrate cross-cutting themes: inclusion of women, Indigenous peoples, Afro-descendants, and local communities; climate, biodiversity, and forest conservation; and institutional capacity and rule of law.

Financing And Resource Mobilization

  • Collaborate with the IDB Global Partnerships Department to mobilize resources from donors and partners.
  • Coordinate and manage various funding mechanisms, including donor resources and IDB’s own funds.
  • Leverage Amazonia Forever’s financial instruments to support strategic solutions for regional development challenges.

Stakeholder Engagement & Community Dialogues

  • Coordinate inclusive engagement with civil society, indigenous and Afro-descendant communities, and traditional Amazonian populations in collaboration with IDB Civil Society Unit.
  • Strengthening partnerships with national and international organizations, donors, and private sector actors.

Knowledge & Innovation Agenda

  • Lead the knowledge and innovation agenda of the Amazonia Forever Program, working in close coordination with the Southern Cone, Andean, and Caribbean Departments to ensure regional integration and strategic alignment.
  • Promote experimental programs and pioneering research to support sustainable development.
  • Oversee development and dissemination of knowledge products aligned with program priorities.

Institutional Partnerships & External Representation

  • Coordinate joint initiatives with IDB Invest and IDB Lab.
  • Ensure integration of cross-cutting themes such as climate resilience, sustainability, and social inclusion within IDB Group.
  • Represent the IDB in global forums and multilateral platforms to promote the Bank’s leadership in Amazonia-related development.
  • Build and strengthen partnerships with other MDBs, international agencies, and private sector actors to support coordinated regional efforts.

What you'll need

  • Education: You hold an advanced degree (master’s or equivalent) from an accredited university in a field of the social sciences or humanities that is relevant to sustainable and inclusive development.
  • Experience: Experience related to advancing sustainable and/or inclusive development in the region.
  • Languages: Proficiency in English, and Spanish or Portuguese.

Professional Experience

  • You have extensive experience conducting strategic-level technical dialogues with diverse groups (e.g. public sector, private sector, civil society, Indigenous and/or traditional communities), including dialogues in matters related to your work.
  • Experience facilitating dialogues and negotiations that directly involved more than one country is a plus.
  • You have experience in connecting strategic-level discussions with realities at the operational level.
  • A working understanding of multi-lateral development banks is advantageous.
  • You have demonstrated understanding of the fundamental economic, socio-cultural, and environmental characteristics of the Amazonian territories within the countries that are the focus of the Amazonia Forever Regional Program.

Requirements

  • Citizenship: You are a citizen of one of our 48-member countries. We may offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Consanguinity: You have no family members (up to the fourth degree of consanguinity and second degree of affinity, including spouse) working at the IDB, IDB Invest, or IDB Lab.

Type of contract and duration

  • Staff: International staff contract, 36 months initially, renewable upon mutual agreement.

What we offer

The IDB group provides benefits that respond to the different needs and moments of an employee's life. These benefits include:

  • A competitive compensation package, including an annual base salary expressed on a net-of-tax basis.
  • Leaves and vacations: 24 days of paid time off + 8 personal days + sick leave + gender-neutral parental leave.
  • Health Insurance: IDB Group provides employees and eligible dependents with a robust medical benefits program that covers medical, dental, vision, preventive care, and prescription drugs.
  • Pension plan: a defined benefit pension plan that provides financial security and supports employees in planning for their future.
  • We offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your family when it applies.
  • Hybrid and flexible work schedules.
  • Health and well-being: Access to our Health Services Center, which provides preventive care and health education for employees.
  • Development support: We offer tools to boost your professional profile, such as mentoring, 1:1 professional counseling, training and learning opportunities, language classes, mobility options, among others.

Our culture

At the IDB, we work so everyone brings their best and authentic selves to work while finding their purpose. Our people consistently strive for excellence, and we recognize and celebrate the impact of their contributions.

In our efforts to drive innovation, we intentionally include all voices, cultivate a sense of belonging and champion fairness. We welcome individuals from underrepresented groups to join us and share their unique perspectives.

description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

Sobre a Vaga

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Nesse papel você será responsável por atuar na administração de registros e documentos escolares. Terá a função de operacionalizar os processos de matrícula e transferência, de organização de turmas e de registros do histórico escolar dos estudantes.

Responsabilidades

O que você fará:

  • Coordenar e executar as tarefas decorrentes dos encargos da Secretaria;
  • Organizar e manter em dia o protocolo, o arquivo escolar e o registro de assentamento dos alunos, bem como a regularidade da vida escolar do aluno;
  • Verificar a autenticidade dos documentos escolares;
  • Organizar e manter em dia a coletânea de leis, regulamentos, diretrizes, portarias, circulares, resoluções e demais documentos;
  • Redigir a correspondência que lhe for confiada, lavrar atas e termos, nos livros próprios;
  • Rever todo o expediente a ser submetido ao despacho da Direção;
  • Apresentar à Direção, em tempo hábil, todos os documentos que devem ser assinados;
  • Zelar pelo uso adequado e conservação dos bens materiais distribuídos à Secretaria;
  • Manter sigilo sobre assuntos pertinentes ao serviço;
  • Responder ao Censo Escolar Anual.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

Requisitos

O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de curso técnico em secretaria escolar ou Licenciatura Plena em Pedagogia;
  • Experiência prévia de pelo menos 1 ano na função;
  • Conhecimento das normas locais que dizem respeito à função;
  • Excel avançado (procv e outras habilidades para manter planilhas de controle atualizadas e poder cruzar listagens).

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Inglês intermediário.

Declaração de Salvaguarda

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. title: Clinical Psychiatrist
description:
Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Clinical Psychiatrist will work as a key member of our multi-disciplinary wellness team at the Howard University College of Medicine’s Center for Spiritual Health and Wellness, providing essential mental health services to our diverse medical student population. They will assess, diagnose, and treat a wide range of psychiatric disorders, using evidence-based therapeutic interventions and programs to promote wellness. The psychiatrist position is an in-person, part-time position (two half-day sessions per week).

Supervisory Authority

The psychiatrist will not have supervisory authority.

Nature And Scope

Works collaboratively and professionally in a multidisciplinary setting. Interacts with students, staff and faculty within the College of Medicine and University Counseling services. Is a member of the team at the Howard University College of Medicine’s Center for Spiritual Health and Wellness.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Conduct comprehensive mental health assessments to identify students’ mental health needs, using a variety of methods such as interviews and psychometric tests.
  • Formulate individualized treatment plans for students, based on their unique needs, and update these plans as necessary throughout the course of treatment.
  • Provide evidence-based psychiatric treatments, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), dialectical behavior therapy (DBT), psychodynamic therapy, or other relevant therapeutic modalities.
  • Coordinate care with the Director of the Wellness Center and the clinical psychologist.
  • Facilitate group therapy sessions, workshops, and wellness seminars as needed, on topics such as stress management, mindfulness, and coping with mental health issues.
  • Document all patient care or other clinical activity appropriately and in a timely fashion in the Electronic Medical Record or approved medical record systems.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development and training activities to stay current with the latest advancements in the field of psychiatry.
  • Provide crisis intervention and management as necessary.
  • Develops, collaborates, or participates in clinical research in the Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences; to the extent possible.
  • Promotes adherence and actively participates in the Health Sciences Compliance Program, the Howard University Code of Ethics and the Health Sciences Standards of Conduct.
  • Attends annual and periodic mandatory Compliance Program training including HIPAA Privacy training.
  • Participates in activities that promote adherence to federal healthcare program requirements.
  • Adheres to the requirements of the HIPAA Privacy Policies and Procedures.
  • Maintains licensure status in DC and continuing education to maintain a strong knowledge base within the profession.
  • Evaluate clients’ emotional, behavioral and mental state through discussion, observation and analysis.
  • Identify mental disorders and determine best treatments, inclusive of therapy, nutrition, stress management, and medications.
  • Administer, score and analyze psychiatric tests and track clients’ progress.
  • Coordinate with external healthcare professionals when hospitalization is required.
  • Advise patients on how to cope with mental diseases and emotional breakdowns.
  • Assumes other duties and responsibilities that are related and appropriate to the position.
  • The above responsibilities are a general description of the level and nature of the work assigned to this classification and is not to be considered as all-inclusive.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge and experience in Clinical Psychiatry, including development, implementation, and supervision of clinical programs or services, and knowledge and experience in a broad range of evidence-based psychiatric treatments, assessments, and understanding of psychiatry standards and practices.
  • Understanding of clinical research methods and experience in clinical research.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment that follows ethical guidelines and College of Medicine procedures.
  • Excellent ability to communicate verbally and in writing in English.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relationships with residents, students, colleagues, staff, physicians, Hospital and University officials and employees, patients, family members, and the general public.
  • Must demonstrate collaboration, accountability, respect, excellence, and service.
  • Works with team members and peers in and outside of their immediate work group to create an exceptional experience for patients, students and other visitors; partners to achieve departmental/institutional results.
  • Accepts responsibility for actions to provide health care and allied functions in a highly efficient and compassionate manner; reflects Howard values.
  • Embraces diversity; cares holistically for those served; maintains patient privacy with meticulous care and keeps information confidential.
  • Anticipates student needs, presents as a model representative of the institution and maintains high standards of care while seeking improvement.
  • Behaves in a friendly, resourceful and professional manner towards all encountered; treats patients, students and visitors with the care they expect for themselves.
  • Maintains licensure and registration for medical license, DEA and controlled substances.

Minimum Requirements

  • Satisfactory completion of a Medical Doctorate (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (D.O.) and a residency program in psychiatry.
  • Board certification in psychiatry by the American Board of Psychiatry and Neurology.
  • Active District of Columbia (D.C.) License to practice psychiatry.
  • Active DEA and Controlled Substance licenses and registrations.

SOBRE A CAPCO
Capco é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e negócios, focada no setor de serviços financeiros e energia. Você trabalhará com tecnologias modernas, incluindo Java e React.js, NoSQL (MongoDB), arquitetura baseada em eventos e ferramentas de observabilidade para garantir que nosso sistema seja altamente observável e fácil de depurar.

  • Conhecimento sólido em NoSQL, com experiência prática em MongoDB.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de sistemas ETL.
  • Experiência com Cloud (AWS, Azure).
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura baseada em eventos e ferramentas relacionadas.
  • Conhecimento em protocolos FTP e manipulação de arquivos posicionais.
  • Habilidade de escrever código limpo, escalável e de fácil manutenção.
  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou área relacionada.
  • Inglês avançado (atuará em time internacional).

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões.
