title: CX - Customer Experience Brazil (São Paulo - Remote
description:
Pessoa Analista de Atendimento ao Cliente - Vagas Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD)

Brazil (São Paulo - Remote

Wellhub (antes, Gympass*) é uma plataforma de bem-estar corporativo que conecta os colaboradores aos melhores parceiros para exercício físico, mindfulness, terapia, nutrição e rotina de sono, tudo incluso em uma assinatura que custa menos do que a individual de cada parceiro. Fundada em 2012 e sediada em Nova York, nossa empresa tem uma equipe crescente em 11 países. No Wellhub, você tem a oportunidade de construir a sua carreira em uma empresa de tecnologia de alto crescimento, que coloca o bem-estar como base da sua cultura e, além disso, contribui para fazer de toda empresa uma empresa de bem-estar.

*Grande novidade: Gympass agora é Wellhub!

Estamos felizes em anunciar nossa mudança de marca para Wellhub, um marco significativo na nossa jornada. Essa transformação reflete nossa evolução de “passe para academias” para uma solução ampla de bem-estar para colaboradores. Com nossa identidade atualizada, estamos prontos para embarcar em um capítulo novo e empolgante de crescimento e expansão. Estamos elevando nossa oferta, incluindo uma experiência completamente nova em nosso app e expansão da rede de nossos parceiros de bem-estar. Veja mais sobre isso aqui.

Por que temos um processo Afirmativo?

Esse é um programa de vagas afirmativas para Pessoa Analista de Atendimento ao Cliente para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD). Nós acreditamos em fomentar a diversidade e nutrir um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, onde todos têm acesso a oportunidades equitativas e alcançar o seu máximo potencial.
Para alcançar a nossa missão, é essencial garantir que todas as pessoas no Wellhub se sintam acolhidas, valorizadas e empoderadas.

A pessoa agente de CX é quem está na linha de frente do atendimento no Wellhub: responde dúvidas, resolve problemas e garante que cada interação com nossos usuários seja clara e acolhedora. Atuando dentro da área de Business Transformation, esse papel conecta o suporte diário à missão maior da empresa, ajudando a transformar processos internos em experiências simples e eficazes para milhões de pessoas que acessam bem-estar todos os dias.

Como Analista de CX, você será responsável por fornecer uma experiência de atendimento de alta qualidade. Trabalhará para a resolução de problemas e atendimento consultivo de usuários, clientes e parceiros através de diversos canais. Sua missão é garantir a confiança do cliente com a nossa marca a partir de interações eficientes, empáticas e profissionais para promover satisfação e fidelidade.

Dentro da área de Atendimento ao Cliente do Wellhub, atuamos em Tribos com foco no perfil específico do cliente. Neste programa teremos posições dentro dos times de: Risk and Fraud , Partners Experience (New Ventures e Partners) , End Users Experience (End User, Reclame Aqui e Social Media)

  • CX Risk and Fraud (Prevention): Você atuará como um "escudo protetor" do ecossistema Wellhub. O foco será analisar dados para identificar e mitigar fraudes, além de se comunicar de forma empática em casos delicados. Você será fundamental para garantir a integridade e a confiança em todas as interações.
  • Foco do Suporte: Fornecer suporte a usuários, parceiros e clientes em vários canais.
  • Análise de Risco: Analisar dados para tomar decisões sobre usuários com potencial de fraude e reportar comportamentos suspeitos que possam causar perdas financeiras à Wellhub.
  • CX New Ventures: Sua principal função será dar suporte direto a parceiros, terapeutas, personal trainers e usuários finais. Você resolverá questões técnicas e complexas em diversos canais para assegurar uma experiência de alta qualidade.
    • Foco do Suporte: Lidar com questões de parceiros e usuários finais, principalmente por e-mail, chat e WhatsApp.
    • Resolução de Problemas: Avaliar as necessidades dos clientes e escalar problemas para outros departamentos ou equipes técnicas quando necessário.
  • CX Partners: Neste papel, você dará suporte direto a parceiros e usuários finais, resolvendo questões técnicas e complexas, como dúvidas, através de vários canais com o objetivo de garantir uma experiência excepcional para o ecossistema dos nossos parceiros.
    • Foco do Suporte: Servir como o principal ponto de contato, oferecendo suporte a parceiros e usuários finais através de múltiplos canais como e-mail, chat e WhatsApp.
    • Gestão e Conformidade: Utilizar o CRM para fornecer informações precisas e manter a aderência aos procedimentos operacionais para um serviço de alta qualidade.
  • CX Reclame Aqui : Você será responsável por resolver tickets de usuários e parceiros com alto nível de fricção no canal Reclame Aqui. Seu objetivo é manter o selo RA-1000 da marca e elevar a reputação e o valor do Wellhub no mercado.
    • Foco do Suporte: Lidar com casos críticos via e-mail, WhatsApp e telefone, com foco em manter a imagem e reputação do Wellhub.
    • Métricas de Desempenho: Monitorar e respeitar KPIs operacionais como SLA de primeira resposta e Tempo de Resolução Total (FRT).
    • Conhecimento Específico: Conhecimento das métricas, regras e plataforma do Reclame Aqui, além de noções básicas do Código de Defesa do Consumidor (CDC).
  • CX Social Media : Você será encarregado de proporcionar a melhor experiência possível para todos os usuários do Wellhub nas redes sociais e em canais de avaliação, como Instagram, Twitter, Google Play Store e Reddit. O objetivo é garantir um serviço ao cliente extremamente satisfatório e ajudar a criar estratégias focadas no cliente.
    • Foco do Suporte: Gerenciar comentários e mensagens em canais como Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, Youtube, TikTok e comunidades como Reddit.
    • Monitoramento da Marca: Detectar oportunidades e possíveis crises de marca, engajando proativamente em menções ao Wellhub (social listening).
    • Estratégia e Conteúdo: Auxiliar na criação de uma estratégia de mídia social coesa, garantir que a voz da marca esteja sempre relevante e manter-se atualizado com as tendências digitais.
  • CX End User: Esta posição é responsável por auxiliar diretamente os Usuários Finais com dúvidas em vários canais, resolvendo problemas técnicos e complexos para garantir uma experiência excepcional.
    • Foco do Suporte: Gerenciar a comunicação com os clientes (e-mail, chat, telefone) para garantir sua satisfação, fornecendo soluções completas e precisas.
    • Métricas de Desempenho: Monitorar e respeitar KPIs operacionais como SLA de primeira resposta e Tempo de Resolução Total (FRT).
    • Conhecimentos Necessários: Utilizar o Zendesk para fornecer informações precisas ao cliente e manter a aderência aos procedimentos operacionais para um serviço de alta qualidade.
  • Ensino médio/técnico completo é o esperado, sendo uma formação universitária considerada um diferencial.
  • Experiência prévia com CX e suporte ao cliente por escrito em diferentes canais de atendimento e níveis de suporte.
  • Conhecimento de sistemas CRM como Zendesk ou Salesforce. Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados como Google Looker, Tableau ou Metabase é um diferencial.
  • Google Workspace (Google Docs, Sheets, etc.) é um diferencial.
  • Excelentes habilidades de gramática e informática.
  • Português nativo é obrigatório para todas as posições. Inglês intermediário é um diferencial.
  • Ter disponibilidade para trabalhar 8 horas por dia, com escala de trabalho aos finais de semana (para as pessoas que atuarão especificamente em CX End User).

Mesmo que você não corresponda a 100% dos requisitos da vaga, candidate-se! Teremos o maior prazer em receber a sua inscrição e analisar o seu fit em nossa equipe. Lembre-se apenas de observar que a experiência prévia com atendimento ao cliente por diferentes canais é obrigatória para estas funções específicas.

Somos uma empresa comprometida com a saúde e bem-estar das nossas pessoas colaboradoras. Oferecemos um pacote de benefícios Flex, que inclui:

WELLHUB: Você receberá o plano Gold+ do Wellhub de graça e outros planos premium com descontos significativos. Você vai poder acessar diversas academias e estúdios fitness, além de soluções de bem-estar, incluindo meditação, nutrição, saúde mental, rotina de sono e mais.

WELLNESS: Seguro Saúde, Odontológico e Seguro de Vida.

TRABALHO FLEXÍVEL : No Wellhub, a flexibilidade gera um ambiente de trabalho mais feliz, saudável e produtivo para todas as pessoas. Como uma empresa de trabalho flexível, oferecemos dois modelos: híbrido-flexível e remoto, e fazemos do escritório um lugar para colaboração e construção de equipe. O modelo para essa posição pode ser discutido com sua pessoa recrutadora e com a gerente de contratação. Você também vai receber um reembolso no primeiro mês de trabalho para equipar seu escritório remoto.

CRONOGRAMA FLEXÍVEL : Entendemos que, juntos, todos os Wellhubbers e suas pessoas líderes podem tomar as melhores decisões para seus escopos particulares. Isso inclui a flexibilidade para ajustar as horas de trabalho com base nos cronogramas pessoais, fuso horário e necessidades de negócio.

CRESCIMENTO PROFISSIONAL: Excelentes oportunidades de crescimento pessoal e profissional com foco no seu desenvolvimento.

CULTURA: Entre em uma atmosfera motivadora e de apoio constante, com pessoas de diversos cantos do mundo. Você vai construir parcerias com colegas de diversos países e fazer parte do sucesso de uma empresa de tecnologia que não para de crescer, que traz soluções revolucionárias no seu segmento. Aqui, a sua autonomia vai se transformar em um impacto duradouro no negócio e no mundo. Nossa cultura baseada em confiança, flexibilidade e integridade torna isso possível todos os dias. Entenda mais sobre ela em nossa página de carreiras .

FÉRIAS/DAY-OFF: Sabemos a importância de tirar um tempo para desconectar do trabalho e recarregar as energias. Por isso, nós oferecemos:

Férias após 6 meses + 3 dias de folga por ano + 1 dia de folga durante o mês do seu aniversário + 1 dia de folga a cada aniversário de casa (somando até 5 dias).

LICENÇA PARENTAL PAGA: Receber um novo filho é um dos momentos mais especiais da vida e nós queremos que as nossas pessoas colaboradoras possam tirar uma licença para aproveitar a família.

Fazemos parte do programa Empresa Cidadã e também oferecemos licença para pais adotivos.

Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão @ Wellhub

O Wellhub é um empregador comprometido com a promoção de oportunidades iguais. Não discriminamos com base em raça, religião, cor, sexo, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência física ou mental não desqualificadora, nacionalidade, condição de veterano ou qualquer outra base coberta pela lei apropriada.

title: Data Engineer - Remote, Latin America
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Data Engineer - Remote, Latin America role at Bluelight

Bluelight Consulting is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight Consulting. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone\'s opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience with AWS services including but not limited to S3, Athena, EC2, EMR, and Glue.
  • Ability to solve any ongoing issues with operating the cluster.
  • Experience with the integration of data from multiple data sources.
  • Experience with various database technologies such as SQLServer, Redshift, Postgres, and RDS.
  • Experience with one or more of the following data integration platforms: Pentaho Kettle, SnapLogic, Talend OpenStudio, Jitterbit, Informatica PowerCenter, or similar.
  • Knowledge of best practices and IT operations in an always-up, always-available service.
  • Experience with or knowledge of Agile Software Development methodologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills with a keen sense of customer service.
  • Experience with collecting/managing/reporting on large data stores.
  • Awareness of Data governance and data quality principles.
  • Well-versed in Business Analytics including basic metric building and troubleshooting.
  • Understand Integration architecture: application integration and data flow diagrams, source-to-target mappings, data dictionary reports.
  • Familiar with Web Services: XML, REST, SOAP.
  • Experience with Git or similar version control software.
  • Experience with integrations with and/or use of BI tools such as GoodData (preferred), Tableau, PowerBI, or similar.
  • Broad experience with multiple RDBMS: MS SQLServer, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redshift.
  • Familiarity with SaaS/cloud data systems (e.g. Salesforce).
  • Data warehouse design: star-schemas, change data capture, denormalization.
  • SQL/DDL queries/Tuning techniques such as indexing, sorting, and distribution.
  • BS or MS degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
  • 3+ years of Data Pipeline development such as SnapLogic or Datastage, Informatica, or related experience.
  • 3+ years of SQL experience (No-SQL experience is a plus).
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining data pipelines.

What You\'ll Be Doing

  • Develop and maintain data models for core package application and reporting databases to describe objects and fields for support documentation and to facilitate custom application development and data integration.

Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Marketing Specialist to join the Strategic Studies & Market Analysis Division of Crude Oil Sales & Marketing Dept (COSMD).

The Strategic Studies & Market Analysis Division is responsible for providing oil market analysis, market intelligence and data analytics, strategic studies and market research, as well as project management and coordination within the crude oil sales and marketing department.

Your primary role is to oversee and manage various marketing activities, drive marketing research initiatives, and optimize performance to support the company’s overall marketing strategies.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate, you will be required to perform the following:

  • Provide expertise in a specialized area with crude oil placement strategy and market analysis.
  • Participate in analysis and strategy development that addresses short- and long-term needs, highly complex issues and challenges.
  • Mentor, train, and develop others to provide awareness of the complex concepts within crude oil markets.
  • Undertake complex studies within your developed area of expertise in crude oil placement strategy and market analysis that can impact the company’s present and future operations.
  • Monitor the development of existing and emerging market trends to forecast their viability and evolution over time.
  • Frequently direct and/or coordinate work task forces on special studies and consult directly with Executive Management on issues as they arise.
  • Provide expert advice and guidance on complex planning and analysis problems to senior planning and analytical personnel and to Executive Management.
  • Collaborate with partners and key internal and external stakeholders on low carbon value proposition, presentation of analytical results as well as support in establishing an organization focused on low carbon product.
  • Provide quantitative and qualitative analysis to support the areas of commercializing low carbon crude oil and low carbon products such as LCAF, SAF, Naphtha and others with focus on offsetting and carbon markets mechanisms.
  • Prepare and present plans, analyses, interpretations, conclusions and recommendations to Management and others on a broad range of petroleum market issues.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, Environmental Science or equivalent from a recognized and approved program.
  • Advanced degree in economics, energy, or MBA is preferred.
  • Over 12 years of experience in oil and gas sustainability, Environment, Social & Governance (ESG) and carbon market industry.
  • Knowledge of carbon markets and environmental regulations related to GHG Emissions with understanding of the compliance carbon markets, voluntary carbon markets, baseline and crediting mechanisms, carbon-related trade measures and carbon pricing.
  • Extensive knowledge of global crude oil market balances and flows; pricing dynamics and structures; and methodologies of reporting agencies and exchange contracts.
  • Familiarity with refinery and petrochemicals, linear programming, and investment financial modeling is preferred.
  • Understanding of refining and refining economics.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

title: Técnico de manutenção
description:
Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.

Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².

Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Técnico de Manutenção, você irá:

  • Ser responsável pela manutenção corretiva e preventiva, assim como solucionar os problemas diários de Guindastes;

Overview

TRM Labs is a blockchain intelligence company committed to fighting crime and creating a safer world. By leveraging blockchain data, threat intelligence, and advanced analytics, our products empower governments, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to combat illicit activity and global security threats. At TRM, you\'ll join a mission-driven, fast-paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily. Whether analyzing blockchain data, developing cutting-edge tools, or collaborating with global organizations, you\'ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact.

We are seeking a Commissions Analyst to ensure accuracy, responsiveness, and scalability in how commissions and revenue operations are managed in a dynamic, high-growth environment with multiple commission plans, frequent changes, and evolving billing needs.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, has a meticulous eye for detail, and is energized by building efficient processes that reduce risk and improve visibility. You’ll work cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, and Operations teams to deliver timely and accurate commissions, resolve system issues, and implement process improvements that scale with the business. This role is critical to ensuring commissions are paid correctly and on time, while also strengthening revenue recognition and reporting processes.

Responsibilities

  • Accurate and reliable commissions: Ensure commission processes are managed with precision, supporting timely and error-free payouts that build trust across the sales organization.
  • Clear visibility into revenue operations: Strengthen reporting and data integrity in Spiff, Salesforce, and billing systems, enabling leadership to make confident, data-driven decisions.

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years of experience in revenue operations, commissions administration, or related finance roles, ideally in a SaaS or high-growth environment.

What to Expect at TRM

TRM moves fast—really fast. We know a lot of startups say that, but we mean it. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full-time employees. TRM may not be the right fit for everyone. If you\'re optimizing for work-life balance, we encourage you to ask about balance within teams and reflect on whether this is the right season in your life to join a high-velocity environment.

The Stakes Are Real: Our work has direct, real-world impact, including supporting urgent government requests, terrorist financing investigations, and global security efforts. We also build new processes quickly to stop criminals before they cash out and analyze blockchain data to recover stolen savings.

Life at TRM

As a remote-first company, TRM is built for global collaboration. We cultivate a strong remote culture through clear communication and meaningful relationships, invest in offsites and onboarding buddies, and prioritize trust and belonging.

Join our mission. We\'re looking for team members who thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and love building from the ground up. If you’re excited about TRM\'s mission, we want to hear from you. TRM is remote-first, with a globally distributed team.

description:
Join to apply for the Business Analyst role at Tort Experts

About Tort Experts

At Tort Experts, we are redefining the landscape of performance marketing in the legal sector. Our mission is to democratize access to information for individuals who have been injured, connecting them with law firms that can truly advocate for their rights and achieve successful outcomes. As an innovative, vertically integrated legal case acquisition marketing company, we leverage cutting-edge technology, data-driven insights, and a commitment to transparency to disrupt the status quo.

Joining Tort Experts means becoming part of a dynamic team that is passionate about making a meaningful impact. We foster a collaborative environment where creativity thrives, and every team member plays a vital role in connecting qualified claimants with the representation they deserve. If you’re looking for a workplace where your contributions can truly make a difference, and where innovation meets purpose, Tort Experts is the perfect place for you.

About The Role

We are hiring a Business Analyst to strengthen our Client Services team by owning reporting, reconciliation, and proactive analysis across client accounts. This role ensures accuracy in case counts and budgets, surfaces performance insights, and creates scalable reporting solutions that empower the entire team.

The ideal candidate is mid-level, highly analytical, and able to take full ownership of results with minimal oversight. They are adept at spotting trends, building actionable reports, and anticipating issues before they become problems. Over time, this role may evolve into a companywide business analyst position, with broader responsibility for insights and reporting across teams.

Location: Remote (must be available 9am - 5p ET)

What You'll Do

Client Reporting & Reconciliation

  • Case Data Reconciliation: Own the process of reconciling signed case counts between internal systems and client reports, resolving discrepancies independently.
  • Fund Reallocations: Accurately process client requests to move budgets across projects, ensuring all updates are reflected in reporting.
  • Custom Reporting: Deliver accurate, client-ready reports that align with goals and expectations, while continuously improving report templates and workflows.

Proactive Analysis & Insights

  • Issue Detection: Monitor conversion rates, lead quality, and profitability by lead type and field values to proactively spot risks and opportunities.
  • Performance Analysis: Provide insights into client and campaign profitability, pricing effectiveness, and lead monetization trends.
  • Self-Serve Reporting: Build dashboards and recurring reports that give team members visibility into critical KPIs without requiring manual analysis each time.
  • Scalable Insights: Develop frameworks for analyzing trends that can be reused across clients and campaigns.

Operational Excellence & Financial Control

  • Accuracy Safeguarding: Ensure all reconciliations, reallocations, and reports are error-free and backed by clear data sources.
  • Process Improvement: Identify inefficiencies in reporting and reconciliation, and create scalable solutions that save time and reduce errors.
  • Collaboration: Support the Director of Client Services by taking on data-heavy work, freeing leadership to focus on strategy and client growth.

Client-Facing Support

  • Email Communication: Participate in client email threads to share reconciled numbers, reporting deliverables, and updates related to reallocations.
  • Light Client Interaction: Join occasional client calls to clarify data, while leaving strategic discussions to the Director of Client Services.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 4–6 years in business analysis, reporting, client operations, or related analytical roles. Experience in legal case acquisition or performance marketing is a plus.
  • Technical Skills: Master level of proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, complex formulas) and reporting dashboards (e.g., Looker, Omni, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Analytical Skills: Strong ability to slice/dice data, reconcile discrepancies, and extract actionable insights across multiple variables (lead type, conversion rates, profitability, etc.).
  • Automation & Tools: Comfortable building repeatable reports, dashboards, and using AI or automation to accelerate data comparison and analysis.
  • Ownership: Able to take responsibility for results with little oversight, quickly becoming the go-to person for reporting and analysis.
  • Communication: Clear, concise written skills for client-facing updates and internal reports.
  • Adaptability: Ability to learn new systems quickly and thrive in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift rapidly.
  • Personal Attributes:
    • Extremely detail-oriented and accuracy-obsessed.
    • High ownership, proactive problem-solver who identifies issues before others see them.
    • Curious and driven to dig into data until key insights emerge.
    • Comfortable in a support role, enabling leadership to focus on higher-level strategy.
    • Growth-oriented, eager to expand from client-level reporting into companywide business analysis.

Benefits

  • Uncapped quarterly profit-sharing bonuses based on company performance
  • 100% company-paid monthly premiums for Fortune 500 level quality insurance plans for you and any/all dependents (US based employees):
    • medical (Aetna)
    • dental (Guardian)
    • vision (Guardian)
  • 100% company match on any employee contributions to either HSA or FSA flex benefits plans (US based employees):
    • $500 free FSA company contribution, even if $0 employee contribution
  • 401k plan with full company match of up to 6% of salary and no vesting period required (US based employees)
  • Unlimited paid time off with planned role/responsibilities coverage
  • Work from home equipment budget (at company's discretion)
  • Forever remote work environment

Why Join Us?

At Tort Experts, we believe in empowering our team members with growth opportunities, a flexible work environment, and the chance to make a tangible impact. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and are driven, client-focused, and eager to contribute to our mission of connecting clients with top-tier legal representation.

title: Developer Relations (Americas)
description:
Overview

Runware is building a leading API for all AI. Our platform makes it easy for developers to add advanced media generation capabilities to their products in hours instead of months, without the burden of managing GPUs, scaling, or constant model updates. By combining custom hardware with optimized software and orchestration, we deliver unmatched speed, reliability, and cost efficiency across hundreds of thousands of models. Backed by top global investors, we're growing quickly and building a team to shape the future of AI development.

About The Role
We\'re looking for Developer Relations to be the technical voice connecting our media generation API with the developer community. You\'ll bridge the gap between our engineering team and the developers building on Runware—from indie creators to enterprise teams integrating our generation capabilities into their products.

First and foremost, you must be passionate about generative AI and able to demonstrate it through project links, technical content, open-source contributions, or other hands-on work. We\'re looking for builders with some development experience. You don\'t need to be a superstar engineer, but you should be comfortable writing and debugging code.

This is an intentionally broad role that will flex around your strengths. It could include creating educational content, debugging integrations, supporting developers, building SDKs and integrations, or representing Runware at events and hackathons. You might maintain SDKs or third-party integrations, build new integrations, or contribute workflow examples and tutorials. A key part of the role is bringing value to our ecosystem which could include being active in public — sharing your work, engaging with other developers, and making technical content visible across socials, forums, and communities. You\'ll help Runware have a strong presence where developers already are.

More than just a job title, this is an invitation to join a company that\'s spearheading the future of AI. We\'re looking for people who want to partner with us, explore their passion for AI, and help other developers succeed. Your technical credibility with developers matters most. Everything else is flexible.

Is this role a fit for you?

If you\'re unsure whether you tick every box below but you\'re excited by AI and have something to show, we\'d love to hear from you. This role is designed to flex around the right people. If you\'ve built projects, contributed to communities, or simply can\'t stop experimenting with generative AI, you already have what matters most. We are even open to freelancers who may just want to contribute in one specific area. Apply and let\'s explore how your passion can grow with Runware.

What This Role Could Entail

  • Write and share technical content — blog posts, guides, videos, and walkthroughs — and distribute it across socials, forums, and developer communities
  • Actively manage and grow our developer community across Discord, Reddit, and social platforms, including hosting office hours, AMAs, workshops, and spotlighting community projects
  • Represent Runware at conferences, hackathons, and developer events, and support inbound interest by helping developers go from first experiment to production usage
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for developers using our API across community channels such as Discord, GitHub, and forums, while surfacing documentation gaps and collaborating with the team to improve clarity
  • Maintain and build our SDKs, plugins, and third-party integrations like ComfyUI or Vercel, and create sample projects, code examples, and workflow tutorials

Requirements

  • First and foremost: you are extremely passionate about AI, particularly generative AI or media generation, and can demonstrate this through project links, technical content, open-source contributions, hackathons, or other hands-on work
  • Some development experience. Comfortable working with schemas, APIs, and full-stack concepts (backend and frontend). The exact languages or frameworks you\'ve used matter less than your ability to build and explain working solutions
  • Experience experimenting with AI technologies such as training LoRAs, building advanced workflows in ComfyUI, or integrating AI models into projects
  • A blend of coding ability and AI know-how. You can navigate developer tooling and generative AI workflows, even if you\'re not a senior specialist in either
  • Excellent technical writing skills. Able to explain complex concepts clearly for developers, and actively share that content across forums, socials, and developer communities
  • Active in developer ecosystems from AI/ML Discord servers and GitHub to hackathons, meetups, or developer events. Comfortable representing and amplifying technical work in public

Benefits

We\'re a remote-first team that comes together in person twice a year to plan, collaborate, and celebrate wins. Day to day we keep a few core hours for teamwork, but outside of that you set the schedule that helps you do your best work.

Our environment is fast-moving and ambitious. Big pushes are part of building category-defining products, but we balance that with flexible working, generous time off, and regular retreats so the team can stay sharp and motivated.

  • Generous paid time off - vacation, sick days, public holidays
  • Meaningful stock options - share in the upside you create
  • Remote-first setup - work from home anywhere we can employ you
  • Flexible hours - own your schedule outside core collaboration blocks
  • Family leave - paid maternity, paternity, and caregiver time
  • Company retreats - twice-yearly gatherings in inspiring locations

Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn’s suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT . The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team.

You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

  • You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc.
  • We’re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise.
  • You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.
  • You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.
  • You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)
  • You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • You’re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them.
  • You'll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints).
  • You’ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You’ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you’re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it’s in tickets, email or Slack. You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone’s time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You’re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.)
  • You’ve used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide

  • As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment.

Overview

Join to apply for the Product Analyst (Call Center Analytics) role at Lendbuzz .

This range is provided by Lendbuzz. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

ARS60,906,721.00/yr - ARS67,672,970.00/yr

About Lendbuzz

At Lendbuzz, we believe financial opportunity should be more personalized and fair. We develop innovative technologies that provide underserved and overlooked borrowers with better access to credit. While our core operations are based in the United States, we are excited to be setting up our presence in Argentina as we continue to grow globally. From our employees to our dealers, partners, and borrowers, we’ve built a company and a culture around a resolute belief in the promise and power of diversity. We value independent and critical thinking - and we’re looking forward to building a strong local team in Argentina to support our mission.

Salary note: The salary range is listed in Argentine Pesos (ARS).

Role

The Senior Product Analyst sits at the intersection of product strategy and call center operations. You’ll play a pivotal role in shaping Lendbuzz’s future by ensuring that both what we build and how our customer interactions are handled are guided by robust, accurate insights. Collaborating closely with product managers, engineers, operations, and customer experience teams, you’ll turn product and call center metrics into actionable recommendations that improve performance, enhance efficiency, and elevate customer experience.

Please apply directly at -

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Analytics: Conduct deep-dive exploratory analyses to understand user pain points, “ah-ah” moments, and product usage insights.
  • Collaborate with product teams to build reusable or ad hoc data views, influencing strategy, design, and development.
  • Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reports using SQL (CTEs, window functions, etc.) or scripting languages, offering real-time visibility into product performance.
  • Track and evaluate the success of product launches and A/B experiments; monitor system and product performance post-launch.
  • Conduct quality checks on analytics events and recommend enhancements to amplify product performance.
  • Participate actively in agile processes, from design through implementation and deployment.

Call Center Analytics

  • Analyze performance metrics (call volumes, handle times, abandonment, NPS/CSAT, agent productivity) to uncover trends and opportunities.
  • Partner with Operations, Product, and CX teams to translate call data into process and product recommendations.
  • Develop dashboards and KPI frameworks to drive decisions around call routing, workforce optimization, and automation.
  • Run root-cause analyses to pinpoint inefficiencies and improve customer journeys.
  • Influence product roadmaps and automation initiatives with thoughtful data insights.
  • Lead A/B tests and other experiments to measure outcomes in call center performance.

Ideal Profile

  • 5+ years of experience in data/product analysis, including call center analytics.
  • SQL expertise; comfortable with complex queries, including CTEs and window functions.
  • Proficiency in BI tools like Sigma, Tableau, or Power BI; experience with DBT is a plus.
  • Basic knowledge of Python and Git.
  • Strong data experimentation and statistical analysis background.
  • Expertise in call center platforms and KPIs; Genesys experience is a plus.
  • Excellent around cross-functional collaboration (Product, Engineering, CX, Ops).
  • Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and business acumen.
  • Creative, proactive, organized, and growth-minded.
  • Fluent in English (written and verbal).

What’s on Offer

  • Flexible working options
  • Work alongside & learn from best in class talent
  • Work within a company with a solid track record of success

Sobre a Avenue
Na Avenue, somos movidos por um propósito claro: expandir o potencial do investidor brasileiro, fazendo sua vida render mais — em dólar. Isso significa oferecer acesso a oportunidades globais de investimento, com produtos, serviços e experiências que ajudam nossos clientes a construir um futuro financeiro mais sólido, diversificado e conectado ao mundo.

Sobre a vaga
Buscamos alguém com visão crítica, capacidade de execução e vontade de construir soluções robustas e escaláveis. Valorizamos quem se envolve com o problema, contribui com o time e busca entregar com qualidade e propósito. Se você gosta de atuar em squads multidisciplinares, com autonomia e responsabilidade, essa vaga é pra você.

No seu dia a dia, você terá como responsabilidade

  • Automatizar o provisionamento, a implantação e a escalabilidade da infraestrutura de software utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC);
  • Auxiliar as equipes de desenvolvimento no provisionamento e sustentação de ambientes, garantindo alta disponibilidade e resiliência;
  • Suportar e aprimorar o ambiente de CI/CD, incluindo práticas de DevSecOps e automação de testes de confiabilidade;
  • Suportar e aprimorar os sistemas de monitoramento, logging e tracing, definindo e acompanhando SLIs, SLOs e SLAs;
  • Automatizar rotinas de infraestrutura e resposta a incidentes, reduzindo MTTR (Mean Time to Recovery);
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para garantir eficiência, escalabilidade e confiabilidade contínua;
  • Desenvolver e manter documentações técnicas detalhadas, incluindo runbooks e playbooks de incidentes;
  • Garantir conformidade com regulamentações do setor financeiro, sem comprometer a performance e a disponibilidade dos serviços;
  • Participar de post-mortems e propor melhorias contínuas para evitar recorrência de falhas.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência na área;
  • Experiência e conhecimento em Kubernetes (incluindo práticas de resiliência e auto-healing), Terraform, Helm, GitHub Actions e pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com provedores de nuvem como Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento como Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog e práticas de observabilidade;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Git e GitOps, como GitHub, ArgoCD ou similares;
  • Experiência com automação de infraestrutura e configuração de sistemas;
  • Habilidade para solucionar problemas complexos, analisar incidentes e propor melhorias estruturais;
  • Experiência com linguagens de script como Python, Bash ou PowerShell;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis como Kanban e Scrum;
  • Vivência com cultura de confiabilidade (SRE mindset).

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento/certificação em DataDog ou outras ferramentas de observabilidade;
  • Certificação Kubernetes Certified Administrator (CKA) ou Kubernetes Certified Application Developer (CKAD);
  • Certificação Terraform;
  • Certificação em um dos provedores de nuvem:
    • Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
    • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
    • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
  • Experiência em implantação de Internal Developer Portal;
  • Experiência em Chaos Engineering ou práticas de resiliência;
  • Vivência com FinOps para otimização de custos em cloud.

Informações adicionais
Essa é uma vaga 100% home office para regime CLT.

Benefícios

  • Vale refeição e vale alimentação atrativos;
  • Plano de Saúde Omint;
  • Plano Odontológico Amil;
  • Seguro de vida MetLife;
  • Wellhub ou TotalPass;
  • Auxílio home office no valor de R$200 reais mensais;
  • Home office boost: incentivo único no valor de R$2.000 depositado assim que você entrar na Avenue para que ajude a dar um upgrade no seu set up;
  • Incentivo educacional (reembolso para cursos, certificações e eventos);
  • Day off no mês do aniversário;
  • Psicologia Viva: sessões de terapia online gratuitas;
  • Auxílio Creche no valor de R$455 para cada filho(a) de até 5 anos;

VEM PRA MADEIRA!!! Na MadeiraMadeira, acreditamos no poder de reinventar reinventar casas, histórias e, principalmente, pessoas.

VEM PRA MADEIRA!!! Na MadeiraMadeira, acreditamos no poder de reinventar reinventar casas, histórias e, principalmente, pessoas. Aqui, crescer é parte da jornada. Se você quer ser protagonista, aprender na prática, colaborar ao lado de pessoas incríveis e construir projetos que deixem um legado significativo na nossa história, seu lugar é aqui com a gente.

A Diretoria de Tecnologia da MadeiraMadeira é composta por mais de 250 pessoas engajadas e determinadas em gerar valor com as melhores soluções em tecnologia e engenharia de dados. Aqui você vai encontrar uma galera apaixonada pelas tendências de tecnologia e que está super disposta a compartilhar conhecimento para crescermos juntos!

Modelo de trabalho Remoto Brasil | Híbrido Curitiba e/ou São Paulo.

Atividades que você vai protagonizar

  • Coletar, limpar e preparar grandes volumes de dados para análise, garantindo a integridade e a qualidade dos dados.
  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos analíticos e algoritmos para extrair insights significativos dos dados.
  • Identificar padrões, tendências e correlações nos dados que possam ser usados para informar decisões de negócios.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de negócios para entender os requisitos e objetivos, e traduzi-los em análises de dados acionáveis.
  • Comunicar os resultados da análise de forma clara e eficaz para partes interessadas técnicas e não técnicas.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e avanços em data science, analytics e tecnologias relacionadas.
  • Extrair, carregar dados de fontes diversas e modelá-los de acordo com as necessidades das áreas de negócio;
  • Preparar e conduzir treinamentos correlatos ao mei de dados;
  • Garantir aplicação das políticas e mecanismos de governança e segurança de dados;
  • Conduzir análises de causas com base em indicadores a fim de identificar melhorias e fraquezas, planejar e implantar respectivas ações de correção.
  • Desenvolver e implementar ferramentas e dashboards de visualização de dados para monitorar métricas-chave e tendências.

Conhecimentos e competências desejados

  • Forte experiência em linguagens de programação como Python para análise de dados.
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL para manipulação e extração de dados de bancos de dados.
  • Conhecimento avançado em construção e uso de APIs para integração de dados.

  • Conhecimentos em implantação de Governança Federada de dados
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de projetos e metodologias ágeis.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita para traduzir conceitos técnicos em linguagem compreensível para stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com colegas de diferentes departamentos.
  • Pensamento analítico e habilidades de resolução de problemas para abordar desafios complexos de dados.
  • Orientação para resultados e capacidade de gerenciar projetos de ponta a ponta.

Um toque especial na nossa decoração

  • Senso de dono;
  • Experiência em cloud AWS

Conheça a MadeiraMadeira

Montar a casa ideal exige muitas peças. E você é uma delas! Transformar a maneira como as pessoas montam e vivem em seus lares é o que nos move todos os dias. Essa é a nossa missão. E a sua, qual é?

Há mais de 10 anos, estamos redesenhando a experiência de montar uma casa com inovação, tecnologia e, acima de tudo, foco nas reais necessidades dos nossos clientes. Hoje, somos a maior plataforma de produtos para casa da América Latina, com mais de 2 milhões de itens disponíveis em nosso e-commerce, marketplace e Guide Shops espalhadas por todo o Brasil.

Viver a experiência MadeiraMadeira é:

  • Construir um time de alta performance com pessoas certas no lugar certo, feedbacks contínuos e uma cultura que valoriza o desenvolvimento contínuo;
  • Trabalhar com obsessão pelo cliente; entregar soluções simples, úteis e encantadoras;
  • Ter vontade e determinação inabaláveis; agir com coragem, disciplina e foco no longo prazo, sempre acreditando no nosso propósito;
  • Colocar o time em primeiro lugar; atuar de forma colaborativa, tomar decisões juntos e executar com responsabilidade;
  • Ser resiliente; transformar obstáculos em aprendizados e adaptar-se às mudanças;
  • Entregar resultados para conquistar o seu espaço; entregar resultados de forma consistente e coletiva;
  • Ter agilidade na execução; errar rápido, aprender rápido e corrigir ainda mais rápido;
  • Ser uma pessoa curiosa; mover-se pela curiosidade, aprender, inovar e liderar;
  • Fazer mais com menos; criar soluções inovadoras com recursos otimizados, agindo com responsabilidade e eficiência.

Diversidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento

Somos um time de mais de 1.500 pessoas que acreditam que as diferenças nos tornam mais fortes. Queremos um ambiente mais diverso, acolhedor, criativo e justo para todas as pessoas. Todas as oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PCD).

Vamos juntos transformar cada casa em um lar onde vidas se constroem, sonhos se realizam e memórias são eternizadas? #VemSerMadeiraLover!

Local: São José dos Pinhais, Paraná, Brazil

description:
Join to apply for the Interim Executive Director role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Reporting to the Founding Director, the purpose of this position is to provide day-to-day leadership for all Center for Journalism & Democracy (CJD) staff while a permanent Executive Director search is conducted. The interim Executive Director will be responsible for implementation and oversight of Center programs at Howard and at its campus partners at various HBCUs. The interim Executive Director will be responsible for operationalizing the vision of the Founding Director, supervising Center staff and its day-to-day operation, and provide guidance to all members of the team. This position will help the Center fulfill its mission: To bolster the field of journalism in service of our multiracial democracy by supporting the teaching and practice of historically informed investigative reporting at Howard University and across the constellation of historically Black colleges and universities (HBCUs). The Center provides academic and financial support to students, faculty and news organizations located at Howard University and the nation’s largest journalism programs located at HBCUs.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for providing supervision for multiple functions within a department. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and coordinates the work of these functions. Typically, responsible for performing some non-supervisory duties in addition to supervisory responsibilities. Performs staff evaluations and makes recommendations regarding pay and/or performance.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include executives, administrators, faculty, students, and staff of the university at large. External contacts include alumni, consultants, representatives from other colleges and universities, visitors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Provide strategic, holistic, high-level oversight and direction for the Center
  • Works closely with the Chief of Staff and Business Manager to manage grant spending and tracking for the CJD’s multi-million dollar grant portfolio
  • Works closely with the Chief of Staff, Business Manager and Development Manager to supervise the development and monitoring of grant proposal budgets and grant reports, ensuring alignment with the University advancement team and relevant grant accounting offices.
  • Creates, in collaboration with division heads, budgets for programming
  • Lead Center staff and directors in developing and implementing programs and ensure alignment across the Center’s strategic pillars
  • Identify and execute strategic partnerships within and outside of the university
  • Develop and execute fundraising campaigns in partnership with the Development Manager
  • Serve as spokesperson to represent the Center externally in public, professional, and community activities
  • Foster an inclusive and productive team culture
  • Create a space for professional development of team members
  • Ensure that the work of the Center is aligned with the Founding Director’s vision and proceeds in a timely and fiscally responsible manner
  • Set clear, measurable goals to direct the Center’s ongoing work and develop systems to evaluate progress towards those goals
  • Lead the development and launch of new projects as appropriate for the Center.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • At least 10 years of experience leading and managing a team of 10+ individuals.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize and bring together a team in pursuit of common, measurable goals
  • Familiarity with journalism and investigative reporting; journalism experience preferred.
  • Proven success in managing multiple, complex, high-profile projects.
  • Demonstrated success performing and leading in a high growth/startup environment.
  • Fundraising experience
  • Experience developing systems and processes in support of implementing a high-level vision.
  • Comfort with developing and managing budgets, including management of intake and use of philanthropic funds.
  • Proven experience in successfully navigating and building partnerships across large, complex organizations.
  • Willingness to provide and receive direct, constructive feedback
  • Passion for working with students and HBCUs
  • Ability to prepare and maintain timely and accurate reports and correspondence.
  • Extensive experience in the use of computers and experience in word processing, spread sheets, database, and power point applications.
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with a diverse population. Must be detail oriented and organized.
  • Ability to exercise discretion and ensure a high-level of confidentiality.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations and work collaboratively across functions, levels, and departments toward shared objectives.
  • Experience navigating policy requirements at an academic institution

Minimum Requirements

Advance degree (Master’s, JD, LLM, Ph.D or equivalent) and a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience.

Fundada em 2017, a Empodera – Transformação Social pelo Esporte é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos com sede no Rio de Janeiro e atuação nacional, que utiliza o esporte e jogos lúdicos como ferramenta para que meninas adolescentes em situação de vulnerabilidade social exerçam seu pleno potencial e direitos. Responsibilities

    • Gerenciar o fluxo de caixa organizacional

    • Analisa e apresenta relatórios financeiros de maneira precisa e oportuna; comunica demonstrações financeiras mensais e anuais; elabora relatórios para prestação de contas; supervisiona a contabilidade financeira, de projetos/programas e doações
    • Fornecer informações financeiras conforme solicitado e responder a consultas
    • Supervisionar e liderar a elaboração do orçamento organizacional anual e planejamento financeiro em conjunto com a diretora executiva; monitorar progresso e mudanças; manter a gestão informada sobre a situação financeira
    • Realizar a conciliação bancária de acordo com o fluxo de pagamento semanal
    • Fornecer atualizações sobre despesas por centro de custo/projeto, bem como outras informações financeiras em tempo hábil
    • Priorizar ações e recursos para alcançar objetivos e contribuir para o desenvolvimento estratégico
    • Gerenciar e monitorar o input das informações financeiras junto ao sistema integrado da organização
    • Emitir notas fiscais conforme obrigações legais
  • FINANCEIRO – GESTÃO DE PROGRAMAS (20%)
    • Manter comunicação com as coordenadoras de projetos para análise dos gastos (reais x orçados)
    • Apresentar a prestação de contas dos projetos nos prazos estipulados
    • Fornecer relatórios financeiros mensais às coordenadoras de projetos, incluindo gastos por centro de custo/projeto
    • Auxiliar na elaboração de orçamentos para editais
    • Garantir que a organização atenda aos requisitos externos dos doadores
    • Comunicação com parceiros para transmitir informações sobre os programas
  • FINANCEIRO – COMPLIANCE (15%)
    • Atualizar e implementar políticas e procedimentos financeiros
    • Coordenar e liderar processos de auditoria
    • Supervisionar a produção do relatório financeiro anual
    • Examinar documentos financeiros e legais para verificar precisão e aderência a regulamentos
    • Garantir uso eficaz e transparente de recursos, conforme políticas internas
  • RECURSOS HUMANOS E DEMAIS ATIVIDADES (15%)
    • Coordenar, acompanhar e colaborar para o desenvolvimento da equipe
    • Garantir folha de pagamento, benefícios e registros de funcionários com eficiência
    • Assegurar conformidade com legislação trabalhista
    • Participação em treinamentos internos e externos
  • ADMINISTRATIVO (10%)
    • Coordenar atividades administrativas da área/equipe
    • Aprimorar/elaborar processos administrativos e políticas internas
    • Supervisionar processos administrativos conforme políticas da Empodera
    • Orientar a equipe sobre procedimentos administrativos e financeiros

Formação: Nível superior completo, com preferência para ciências contábeis, administração ou economia.

Conhecimentos e experiência: Pacote Office avançado (especialmente Excel); mínimo de 3 anos em rotinas administrativas, financeira, contábeis e de pessoal (fluxo de caixa, contas a pagar/receber, elaboração de orçamento, conciliação bancária); experiência comprovada no setor administrativo-financeiro em organizações da sociedade civil (altamente desejável); experiência com coordenação de equipes; experiência com prestações de contas para agências das Nações Unidas (desejável); experiência com elaboração, execução, prestação de contas e auditoria de projetos nacionais e internacionais; experiência com controles internos e bancários; experiência com Ongsys ou outro ERP (diferencial).

Habilidades: Colaboração, atenção aos detalhes, autonomia, organização, proatividade, boa administração de tempo, relacionamento interpessoal e facilidade de trabalhar em equipe; idioma: inglês (diferencial).

Condições

  • Contratação: CLT, por prazo indeterminado
  • Carga horária: 40 horas semanais
  • Salário: R$ 7.235,00 (bruto)
  • Benefícios: vale-transporte, vale-refeição ou alimentação, seguro de vida, day-off de aniversário, convênio com SESC, Zenklub e Total Pass
  • Início: Setembro/25
  • Formato de trabalho: presencial no escritório no centro do Rio de Janeiro – RJ e flexibilidade para remoto (1x na semana).

Como candidatar

Envie carta de apresentação, compartilhando seu interesse e motivação em trabalhar na Empodera, junto com o currículo em PDF, para ******, com o assunto: “VAGA Coordenação administrativa-financeira pleno”. Prazo para envio de candidaturas até 31/08/2025.

description:
Lead Machine Learning Engineer, Ad Performance

As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology.

Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

We turn audience attention into action through data, machine learning, and relentless optimization.

Are you a Machine Learning Engineer with a passion for bridging technical expertise and business acumen? Do you thrive in building scalable, reliable systems that directly move revenue? If you’re eager to collaborate globally, face challenges head-on, and make substantial impact, we’re looking for you to join our dynamic team.

In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of advertising algorithms, personalization, and optimization… building the ML software and infrastructure that drives ad performance and user engagement at scale.

MUST HAVE

You bring both the technical depth to design and deploy complex ML systems and the business intuition to know what actually moves KPIs. Specifically:

  • 7+ years of software development and ML engineering, including 3+ years focused on advertising systems
  • Proven experience optimizing ad performance using both mature models and emerging ML technologies
  • Expertise in one or more ML areas: Recommendation Systems, Advertising Algorithms, NLP, or CV
  • Proficiency with Python, SQL, and modern ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch)
  • Familiarity with distributed data processing (Spark, Ray) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP)
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills with a proven track record of delivering measurable results
  • Excellent communication, teamwork, and project management skills

YOUR ROLE

Your mission: Elevate Launch Potato’s advertising performance by building scalable, production-ready ML systems that optimize revenue while enhancing user experience. You’ll collaborate across teams to design, deploy, and refine algorithms that improve ad targeting, relevance, and efficiency at global scale.

OUTCOMES

  • Develop and scale advertising algorithms that optimize engagement and revenue simultaneously
  • Apply cutting-edge ML approaches (e.g., reinforcement learning, deep learning for ranking) to improve ad performance
  • Build scalable infrastructure to support real-time ad decisioning across millions of requests per day
  • Conduct rigorous experiments (A/B and multivariate tests) to measure model impact on business KPIs
  • Continuously improve ETL pipelines and monitoring systems to ensure reliable ad delivery
  • Collaborate with global teams across product, data, and engineering to launch high-impact ad features
  • Stay ahead of emerging technologies and integrate them into our ML stack when they create competitive advantage

COMPETENCIES

  • Impact-Oriented : You align ML systems to business outcomes and measure what matters
  • Technical Builder : You write clean, production-ready code and architect scalable systems
  • Collaborative : You work seamlessly with global teams and communicate complex ideas clearly
  • Resilient & Determined : You don’t shy from challenges and drive projects through to impact
  • Curious Innovator : You keep pace with ML/AI trends and creatively apply them to advertising
  • Analytical Problem-Solver : You break down complex systems and find data-driven solutions

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

description:

The primary goal of the project is the modernization, maintenance and development of an eCommerce platform for a big US-based retail company, serving millions of omnichannel customers each week. Solutions are delivered by several Product Teams focused on different domains - Customer, Loyalty, Search and Browse, Data Integration, Cart.   • Experience of work in distributed teams, with US customers

title: TÉCNICO DE GESSO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Join to apply for the TÉCNICO DE GESSO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Organizar a sala de imobilização, checando os equipamentos e materiais necessários para realização de procedimentos de acordo com as solicitações médicas, acolhendo os pacientes de modo que sejam atendidos continuamente em suas necessidades.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio Completo.
  • Curso de Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica Completo;
  • Experiência de 06 meses comprovada na função de Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica/Técnico de Gesso.

Informações adicionais

Local: Santa Cruz - RJ

Escala: 12 horas de trabalho X 36 horas de descanso

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

title: Data Scientist II / Senior Data Scientist
description:
We are hiring multiple Data Scientists across LATAM to join the Microsoft 365 team. These are remote positions, allowing you to work from the comfort of your home!

As part of our team, you will help shape one of Microsoft’s fastest-growing cloud services. Your work will directly impact Copilot, enabling personalized, context-aware experiences that empower millions of users across Microsoft 365.

Do you want to collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, and researchers to design, implement, and evaluate models and algorithms that continuously adapt and improve based on user interactions and feedback? Do you want to leverage advanced machine learning and information retrieval to predict and optimize memory content selection, representation, and lifecycle management.

You will work at the forefront of applied AI and machine learning, shaping the future of intelligent productivity tools. You will contribute to a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and experimentation.

The Substrate Core Substrate team powers the infrastructure that underpins Microsoft 365’s most critical services and Copilot. We are a high-impact, forward-looking team focused on building intelligent, scalable, and cost-efficient platforms that enable Microsoft to deliver world-class productivity experiences to billions of users. Our mission is to drive operational excellence and innovation across the M365 fleet by leveraging AI, automation, and deep platform integration.

Your core mission will be to deliver exciting innovation in Microsoft Copilot. Microsoft Copilot is revolutionizing how people work and have created an unprecedented opportunity to advance the state-of-the-art in a way that benefits millions of people.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and evaluate ML models using prepared datasets, customer feedback, and novel training/fine-tuning algorithms for language models.
  • Write production-quality code, apply debugging best practices, and stay current with industry trends.
  • Drive customer-centric solutions by aligning with business goals and managing stakeholder expectations.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to define success metrics and improve AI quality at scale.
  • Lead research projects that yield new algorithms, tools, or insights solving open problems.
  • Analyze evaluation outputs to identify gaps in coverage, quality, and usability.
  • Design experiments, define metrics, and develop ML pipelines for encoder-decoder and cross-encoder models, semantic search, and user intent understanding.
  • Work with large-scale data while championing privacy and compliance.
  • Engage with customers and internal teams to identify pain points and drive impactful improvements.
  • Stay engaged with the latest research and foster a strong applied science culture. Publishing is encouraged.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in predictive analytics, statistics, or research.
  • Experience with synthetic data generation and data management for evaluation/training.
  • At least one year of experience publishing patents or peer-reviewed papers.
  • Deep motivation for user-centric AI and interest in human cognition, memory, and AI.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience with large-scale embedding models and transformer architectures.
  • Familiarity with reinforcement learning and distributed computing platforms (e.g., Heron, AML, Euclid).
  • Proficient analytical skills and experience with telemetry and performance metrics.
  • DevOps experience and cloud services knowledge (Azure preferred).
  • Agile development experience and a structured approach to software design.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Growth mindset with resilience and a passion for learning.
  • Commitment to diversity, inclusion, and authentic collaboration.
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences.
  • Ownership mindset with the ability to deliver results and manage expectations.
  • Self-motivated and collaborative across teams and organizations.
